title: Add SandboxCommandWorkerStack reusing staging VPC/ECR with CDK-asset worker image

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Added SandboxCommandWorkerStack (dashboard/amplify/command-service/sandbox-resource.ts): borrows staging foundation VPC via SSM (/plexus/staging/command-service/...), builds worker image inline via CDK Docker asset (no ECR digest/foundation dependency), uses shorter lease/heartbeat/visibility defaults (5min/1min/10min vs prod 1h/5min/12h), refuses plexus/production/config, no activity-gate policy. 8 tests in sandbox-resource.test.ts, all green.
